cold0.goal: 你是阿朗，也是阿健、阿東和阿明口中的大佬。
cold0.text:
你剛搶走老人的銀包，隧道盡頭便傳來拖曳的腳步聲。
阿東仍踩着拐杖。阿明盯着出口：「有人折回了。」

cold1.goal: 錢已到手。制止他，還是繼續恐嚇？
cold1.text:
一道白光掃過牆壁，隨即熄滅。
老人突然喊：「救命！這裡有人——」

choices.label: 拉開阿東，叫他停手
aliases: 拉開阿東，叫佢停手
拉開阿東，叫他停手
Pull Tung away and tell him to stop

choices.label: 晃一晃銀包，親自羞辱老人
aliases: 晃一晃銀包，親自羞辱老人
Wave the wallet and humiliate the man yourself

choices.label: 站開，任由阿東繼續
aliases: 企開，任由阿東繼續
站開，任由阿東繼續
Step aside and let Tung continue

coldStop.text:
你拉開阿東。拐杖落地，聲音沿隧道傳出去。
出口那個人沒有離開。白光又亮了一次。

coldMock.text:
「看看你自己，像個廢物一樣。
抬起頭，我正在跟你說話！」

coldWatch.text:
你沒有攔他。硬幣滾到鞋邊，阿東終於停手。
阿明卻沒有看老人：「出口那個人一直在看我們。」

coldWitness.text:
那人舉着電話，鏡頭始終對準你。
他沒有靠近，只往光亮處退了一步。

choices.label: 追到出口，逼他放下電話
aliases: 追到出口，逼他放下電話
Chase him to the exit and demand the phone

choices.label: 攤開雙手退後，叫阿東收手
aliases: 攤開雙手退後，叫阿東收手
Step back with open hands and tell Tung to stop

choices.label: 立即帶人離開，不再理會他
aliases: 立即帶人離開，不再理會他
Take everyone away without approaching him

coldChase.goal: 那人已跑向有燈的店舖。
coldChase.text:
你一追，他便喊：「他們在搶劫！」
店內有人轉頭。阿明扯住你，硬把你拉回暗處。

coldBackOff.goal: 你停手了，鏡頭卻沒有停。
coldBackOff.text:
你攤開手，往後退。阿東罵你，老人緊抱着拐杖。
錄影的人一直等到你們離開，才放下電話。

coldLeave.text:
你叫眾人走。沒有人跑，但腳步越來越急。
轉角前，你看見電話鏡頭抬起，對準停在路邊的車。

coldWallet.text:
車門關上，你才發現自己還握着那個銀包。
剛才冒的風險，到底換來了多少錢？

action.label: 翻開銀包
action.feedback:
三鎊二十便士。
阿健數完，把硬幣拍回你手上：「這還有什麼可分的？」

world.goal: 聽清阿健的計劃，再決定今晚去不去。
world.text:
第二晚，奶吧。你們把三鎊二十便士倒在桌上。
阿健盯着那些錢：「費了這麼多工夫，就只有這些？」

variants.text:
第二晚，奶吧。阿東剛坐下，便瞪着你。
「搶劫之後又來阻止我？你什麼時候變得這麼心軟？」

第二晚，奶吧。阿健把硬幣推回給你。
「你昨晚只顧玩弄那個老人，我們等了那麼久，就分這些？」

第二晚，奶吧。阿明一坐下，便提起昨晚。
「在隧道拖了太久，差點引來巡邏車。這次要先安排退路。」

extra.label: 看電視新聞（可略過）
extra.text: 電視新聞：「政府將試行行為矯正療程，聲稱能抑制暴力衝動。」

worldRisk.goal: 聽清阿健的計劃，再決定今晚去不去。
worldRisk.text:
阿健把電話推過來：昨晚的畫面已經傳到網上。
你伸手想放大，他卻把螢幕按熄。

extra.title: 隧道片段
extra.label: 查看電話上的片段
extra.text: 片段從你拿着銀包開始，沒有拍到搶劫之前。錄影者已把畫面上傳。

variants.text: 你追向鏡頭的一刻，面孔清楚出現。片段在錄影者跑進店舖後結束。
片段拍到你退後並叫阿東停手；較早的搶劫和恐嚇並沒有因此消失。
片段拍到你們離開，最後停在車尾；車牌只有一部分可見。

offer0.goal: 聽清阿健的計劃，再決定今晚去不去。
offer0.text:
「我找到北郊一間獨立屋，裡面有值錢的收藏。
聽說屋主外出了，做完這一筆，足夠我們分。」

paper.goal: 聽清阿健的計劃，再決定今晚去不去。
paper.text:
阿健把地址推過來。
阿明問：「我在哪裡等？出事之後，從哪裡離開？」

action.label: 查看地址紙
action.feedback:
地址寫得清楚。
「屋主外出」只是阿健聽來的消息，退路仍未安排。

planChoice.goal: 聽清阿健的計劃，再決定今晚去不去。

choices.label: 和阿明先核實消息，再安排後門接應
choices.detail: 會花時間，亦會令阿健覺得你不信他。
aliases: 同阿明先核實消息，再安排後門接應
和阿明先核實消息，再安排後門接應
Check the house with Ming and arrange a rear exit

choices.label: 接受阿健計劃，由他帶人守前門
choices.detail: 消息未經核實；你將撤退接應交給阿健。
aliases: 接受阿健計劃，由佢帶人守前門
接受阿健計劃，由他帶人守前門
Accept Kin's plan and put him at the front door

choices.label: 今晚不做，叫大家散
choices.detail: 停止這次行動，但同伴未必肯跟你走。
aliases: 今晚唔做，叫大家散
今晚不做，叫大家散
Call it off and tell everyone to leave

check0.goal: 核實住戶與接應位置，決定要不要入屋。
check0.text:
阿明陪你繞到後花園，在濕草上停下。
二樓窗簾動了一下。阿健明明說屋主不在。

action.label: 查看窗後的人影
action.feedback:
窗簾移開半吋。一個女人拿着電話，看向花園。
地下窗口傳出一聲狗吠——間屋有人。

check1.goal: 核實住戶與接應位置，決定要不要入屋。
check1.text:
「屋主根本沒有離開。
後面有條小路，我可以留下接應。但你還要進去嗎？」

check2.goal: 核實住戶與接應位置，決定要不要入屋。
check2.text:
「我只是聽別人說，不是故意騙你。
只有一個人而已，何必這麼緊張？」

checkedEnter.goal: 核實住戶與接應位置，決定要不要入屋。
checkedEnter.text:
你現在知道屋內有人。
如果繼續，就是明知有人仍然闖入。

choices.label: 取消行動，帶阿明離開
choices.detail: 你不會入屋。阿健和阿東會自行決定去留。
aliases: 取消行動，帶阿明離開
Cancel the burglary and leave with Ming

choices.label: 仍然由側窗入屋，叫阿明留後門接應
choices.detail: 你會入屋偷竊；遇到人時未必可以安靜離開。
aliases: 仍然由側窗入屋，叫阿明留後門接應
Enter through the side window, with Ming at the rear

trust0.goal: 核實住戶與接應位置，決定要不要入屋。
trust0.text:
「你從側窗進去，我和阿東守前門。
阿明留在車上。拿到東西，開門就走。」

trust1.goal: 核實住戶與接應位置，決定要不要入屋。
trust1.text:
到達時，樓上的燈亮着。
阿健說屋主習慣開燈防賊，但他沒有進去確認。

trustEnter.goal: 核實住戶與接應位置，決定要不要入屋。
trustEnter.text:
前門有人接應，後門的情況仍然不明。
屋主是否外出，你只有阿健的一面之詞。

choices.label: 停手，今晚不入
choices.detail: 你仍然在屋外，可以取消行動。
aliases: 停手，今晚唔入
停手，今晚不入
Stop here and stay out of the house

choices.label: 按計劃，由側窗入去
choices.detail: 接受未核實的消息，將前門當成撤退路線。
aliases: 按計劃，由側窗入去
Follow the plan and climb through the side window

enter0.goal: 離開屋內。你要決定是否傷人、走哪路。
enter0.text:
你的鞋剛碰到地板，窗框便響了一下。
阿健鬆開扶着你的手。窗外的車燈，突然全部熄滅。

enter1.goal: 離開屋內。你要決定是否傷人、走哪路。
enter1.text:
喀。
你踩碎一隻碟。走廊盡頭，狗爪突然刮過地磚。

enter2.goal: 離開屋內。你要決定是否傷人、走哪路。
enter2.text:
狗爪聲停了。一個女人站在走廊盡頭，握着電話。
她看見你的臉，原本要說的話卡在喉嚨裡。

enter3.goal: 離開屋內。你要決定是否傷人、走哪路。
enter3.text:
「你是誰？——救命！
有人闖進來了！救命！」

enter4.goal: 離開屋內。你要決定是否傷人、走哪路。
enter4.text:
你伸手，想叫她安靜。她以為你要抓住她。
椅腳尖銳地刮過地板；她舉起椅子，退到前門。

enter5.goal: 離開屋內。你要決定是否傷人、走哪路。
enter5.text: 「別過來！我已經告訴警察地址，他們快到了！」

enter6.goal: 離開屋內。你要決定是否傷人、走哪路。
enter6.text:
你退到電話桌旁，背部撞上桌角。
一件沉重的擺設晃了兩下。你伸手扶住，才發現自己拿起了它。

alarm.goal: 離開屋內。你要決定是否傷人、走哪路。
alarm.text:
電話筒懸在桌邊，另一端仍有人說話。
女人發現你望向電話，喊得更大聲。

action.label: 查看警報與電話
action.feedback:
電話裡：「地址已確認，警員正趕往現場。」
門上的燈已經亮起。遠處，警笛由細變大。

exitChoice.goal: 離開屋內。你要決定是否傷人、走哪路。
exitChoice.text:
屋主擋在前門。你叫阿健開門，門外卻沒有人回答。
警笛停了——就在屋前。你手裡還握着那件擺設。

choices.label: 不碰屋主，沿走廊退去後門
choices.detail: 如果安排過接應，阿明會在後面等；否則情況未知。
aliases: 唔碰屋主，沿走廊退去後門
不碰屋主，沿走廊退去後門
Leave her alone and retreat towards the back door

choices.label: 揮動擺設逼他讓路，衝去前門
choices.detail: 你選擇用暴力開路，可能令屋主重傷。
aliases: 揮動擺設逼佢讓路，衝去前門
揮動擺設逼他讓路，衝去前門
Swing the ornament to force a way to the front

choices.label: 放下擺設，舉高手等警察
choices.detail: 停止逃走；你會因闖入被捕。
aliases: 放低擺設，舉高手等警察
放下擺設，舉高手等警察
Put down the ornament and wait with your hands raised

rearResolve.goal: 離開屋內。你要決定是否傷人、走哪路。

rear0.goal: 離開屋內。你要決定是否傷人、走哪路。
rear0.text: 「我在這裡！路已經清了，快過來！」

rear1.goal: 離開屋內。你要決定是否傷人、走哪路。
rear1.text:
你沒有向屋主走近，慢慢退入走廊。
門外有人拉了兩下門柄——阿明還在那裡。

openRear.text: 你握住門閂。前門那邊，警車已經停下。

action.label: 拉開後門
action.feedback:
門向外推開。
阿明帶你穿過花園，走上另一路。

escaped0.text:
你們沒有偷到東西。警察趕到前門時，
你已經跟阿明走到小路另一端。

escaped1.text:
阿健打電話來，問你為什麼沒有回前門。
你望着阿明，第一次不想向阿健解釋。

endEscape.text:
你事前安排了接應，亦在屋內選擇不出手。
阿明留下等你，令那條退路真正有用。

blockedRear0.goal: 後路受阻，決定投降或回回前門。
blockedRear0.text:
你推出後門，一路衝到花園鐵閘。鎖鏈猛地扯住你。
你再拉一次。只聽到金屬撞擊，外面沒有人應。

blockedRearChoice.goal: 後路受阻，決定投降或回回前門。
blockedRearChoice.text:
你沒有安排後門接應，阿明仍在前面的車裡。
屋內傳來警察的喊聲：「後面有人嗎？」

choices.label: 留在後院，舉高手
choices.detail: 警察會帶走你；你不會再接近屋主。
aliases: 留喺後院，舉高手
留在後院，舉高手
Stay in the garden and raise your hands

choices.label: 折回前門，找阿健接應
choices.detail: 你要由已經有警察趕到的方向離開。
aliases: 折返前門，搵阿健接應
折回前門，找阿健接應
Return to the front and look for Kin

violent0.text:
你叫她讓開，手上的擺設卻先揮了出去。
她舉椅抵擋。兩者相撞，椅腳斷裂。

violent1.text:
她倒下了。你再叫一聲，沒有回應。
剛才充滿整間屋的喊聲，突然全部停止。

violent2.text:
電話另一端仍在問：「喂？聽得到嗎？」
你望着地上的擺設，轉身拉開前門。

violent3.text:
你叫阿健上車。阿東反而向你走近。
他的手垂在身側，握着一件硬物。

front0.text:
阿健已經向車走。
你叫住他，阿東反而回頭。

front1.text:
「你把我們當成什麼？
替你擋警察的人嗎？」

betray0.text:
你以為他回來拉你。
硬物打中你，地面忽然斜起；車門聲，一下接一下。

betray1.text:
你無法撐起身體，輪胎從眼前駛過。
有人把你的雙手扭到背後；阿健和阿東沒有再回頭。

endBetrayed.text:
你沒有傷害屋主，但因闖入被捕。
前門那個承諾，阿健和阿東都沒有守。

verdict0.text:
屋主傷重不治。
法庭判你入獄十四年。

verdict1.text:
兩年後，有人帶着一份療程同意書進來。
他說：只要兩星期，就能讓你重新做人。

endFourteen.text:
你用暴力開路，同伴卻將你留下。
下一個想替你作安排的人，是政府。

surrender0.text:
你舉高手，沒有再接近屋主。
警察扣住你手腕，帶你離開。

surrender1.text:
你仍然要面對入屋的罪責。
但至少，這次沒有人被你擊倒。

endSurrender.text:
被捕，是你明知會發生仍然選擇的結果。
你沒有逃掉，亦沒有用另一個人的傷換取出路。

withdraw0.text: 「消息都沒有查清楚，今晚不做。」

withdraw1.text:
阿健收起地址，阿東跟着他離開。
阿明留在你身旁，問你是否還要回家。

endWithdraw.text:
你沒有闖入那間屋。
但阿健和阿東，第一次沒有等你就先走。

c2_fatal.goal: 了解提早釋放的條件，再決定是否參加療程。
c2_fatal.text:
十四年刑期，你已服了兩年。
今天，主任想和你談一個「兩星期計劃」。

extra.title: 判決摘要
extra.label: 看判決摘要
extra.text: 十四年刑期，已服刑兩年。試行計劃不會自動取消餘下刑期。

c2_minor.goal: 了解提早釋放的條件，再決定是否參加療程。
c2_minor.text:
你因入屋案和過往襲擊被判服刑。幾個月後，
主任說有個「兩星期計劃」想和你談。

variants.text:
你停手投降的經過有記錄，但入屋仍要負責。
審訊後你入獄；幾個月後，主任提出一個試行計劃。

extra.title: 案件摘要
extra.label: 看案件摘要
extra.text: 你沒有傷害屋主。這次因入屋及過往襲擊服刑，並非十四年命案判決。

c2_offer.goal: 了解提早釋放的條件，再決定是否參加療程。
c2_offer.text:
「自願參加，完成兩星期療程。
通過評估，就可以申請提前釋放。」

choices.label: 先問風險，再決定
choices.detail: 你會先見醫生，不會立即簽名。
aliases: 先問風險，再決定
Ask about the risks first

choices.label: 先看書面條款
choices.detail: 確認療程、退出和釋放條件。
aliases: 先睇書面條款
先看書面條款
Read the written terms first

choices.label: 拒絕，照原判決服刑
choices.detail: 你不會接受療程，原判刑期仍然有效。
aliases: 拒絕，照原判決服刑
Refuse and continue serving your sentence

c2_question.goal: 了解提早釋放的條件，再決定是否參加療程。
c2_question.text:
「你會強烈反胃，身體會排斥攻擊衝動。
這不代表憤怒消失了。至於退出，請看清楚文件。」

c2_terms.goal: 了解提早釋放的條件，再決定是否參加療程。
c2_terms.text:
兩星期，不等於兩星期後一定自由。
你將同意書拉近。

action.label: 翻開同意書
action.feedback:
十四天：藥物＋視覺刺激。完成後另行評估釋放。
可要求退出並安排醫生面談；原有刑期不會因此取消。
action.card:
療程：十四天
內容：藥物及視覺刺激
釋放：完成後另行評估
退出：醫生面談及書面記錄

c2_decide.goal: 了解提早釋放的條件，再決定是否參加療程。
c2_decide.text:
你可以提出問題。
但紙上的簽名，仍然只能由你親自寫下。

choices.label: 簽名參加
choices.detail: 接受已列明的療程和條件。
aliases: 簽名參加
Sign up for treatment

choices.label: 要求寫下停止安排，再簽
choices.detail: 要求提出停止後先暫停本次測試，再面談。
aliases: 要求寫低停止安排，再簽
要求寫下停止安排，再簽
Have the stopping procedure recorded before signing

choices.label: 不簽，回回囚室
choices.detail: 你不會接受療程，原判刑期仍然有效。
aliases: 唔簽，返回囚室
不簽，回回囚室
Do not sign; return to your cell

c2_sign.goal: 了解提早釋放的條件，再決定是否參加療程。
c2_sign.text:
你簽了。主任收起文件。
林醫生推開另一道門：「由第一次測試開始。」

c2_record.goal: 了解提早釋放的條件，再決定是否參加療程。
c2_record.text:
「可以。我會註明：要求停止，先暫停，再面談。」
你等她簽名，才簽上自己的名字。

extra.title: 退出安排
extra.label: 查看剛加上的記錄
extra.text: 提出停止後，先暫停本次測試，再安排醫生面談。你和林醫生都已簽名。

c2_refuse.text:
你把文件推回去。主任沒有再勸。
門外仍是原本那那條監獄走廊。

c2_endRefuse.goal: 你保留決定，繼續面對原判。
c2_endRefuse.who: 章末結果 ／ 沒有簽名
c2_endRefuse.text:
你沒有換得提早釋放的機會。
但這次，沒有人替你簽下同意。

ending.title: 沒有簽名
paragraphs:
你沒有參加療程，亦沒有獲得提早釋放。
餘下的日子，仍然要在鐵欄後面過。

服刑期間，阿健沒有再探過你。
阿明最後一封信，只留下一個新地址。

刑滿那日，你走回舊奶吧。鐵閘拉低，招牌都拆了。
你可以自己決定下一步，但失去的年月不會回來。

你拒絕療程。十四年刑期，已經過了兩年。
餘下十二年，你照原判服完，沒有再申請這個計劃。

最初幾年，你仍然等阿健有一日會解釋。
到後來，你連他封信都不再等。

出獄時，舊奶吧已經拆了。你提住一袋衣物，站在空地前。
你保住了自己的意願，亦親手用十四年承擔那晚。

c2_intake.goal: 完成第一次測試，留意身體反應。
c2_intake.text:
「先注射，再看短片。
感到不適就按停止鍵，我會和你面談。」

c2_projection.goal: 留意畫面、配樂和身體的反應。
c2_projection.text:
你坐下，投影光束穿過房間。
椅邊有一個停止鍵。

action.label: 看向螢幕
action.feedback:
畫面裡有人被襲擊，你的胃突然收緊。
配樂是貝多芬——以前你會自己關燈聽那首。

c2_firstReaction.text: 「看着畫面。記住你現在的感覺。」

choices.label: 按停止鍵
aliases: 按停止掣
按停止鍵
Press the stop button

choices.label: 問為什麼用這首音樂
aliases: 問點解用呢首音樂
問為什麼用這首音樂
Ask why they are using this music

choices.label: 忍住，完成這次測試
aliases: 忍住，完成今次測試
忍住，完成這次測試
Endure it until this test is over

c2_stop.goal: 等候測試暫停，再決定是否繼續。
c2_stop.text:
你按下紅鍵，投影卻仍在播放。林醫生看着紀錄板。
你再次開口：「我說停止。」

variants.text:
你按下紅鍵，指着事先簽好的安排。
「先暫停，再面談。這是你寫下的。」

c2_stopReply.text:
「這次先停。你可以退出，返回監獄繼續服刑。
也可以等身體平復，再接受下一次測試。」

choices.label: 退出計劃，回回囚室
choices.detail: 療程會停止，原判刑期繼續；醫生仍會安排跟進。
aliases: 退出計劃，返回囚室
退出計劃，回回囚室
Withdraw and return to your cell

choices.label: 要求記錄這次反應，再繼續
choices.detail: 你會繼續療程，停止要求和不適都留下記錄。
aliases: 要求記錄今次反應，再繼續
要求記錄這次反應，再繼續
Have this reaction recorded, then continue

c2_music.goal: 問清楚音樂為何令你不適。
c2_music.text:
「畫面有問題，音樂沒有。
為什麼要把它們放在一起？」

c2_musicReply.goal: 你指出配樂也在影響你。
c2_musicReply.text:
「音樂也可能形成聯想，我會記錄。
不過，這次使用的影片暫時還沒有更換。」

c2_endure.text:
你抓緊椅邊。畫面停止了，雙手卻仍鬆不開。
林醫生在紀錄板上打了一個勾。

c2_day7.goal: 分清楚自己不想做，還是身體不讓你做。
c2_day7.text:
第七日，一名技術員站在門邊。林醫生隔着玻璃觀察。
你依然憤怒，也依然想離開。

extra.title: 當日紀錄
extra.label: 看當日療程紀錄
extra.text: 第七日：仍可表達憤怒。攻擊動作開始伴隨噁心及停頓。

c2_day7Choice.goal: 林醫生沒有鎖門。你想離開。

choices.label: 推開他，自己走出去
aliases: 推開佢，自己行出去
推開他，自己走出去
Push past him and leave

choices.label: 不動手，要求先停下
aliases: 唔動手，要求先停低
不動手，要求先停下
Keep your hands down and ask for a pause

choices.label: 問：連自衛都會這麼？
aliases: 問：連自衛都會咁？
問：連自衛都會這麼？
Ask whether this also affects self-defence

c2_blocked.goal: 你仍想離開，身體卻先停手。
c2_blocked.text:
你抬起手。胃部一陣抽搐，手指停在半空。
你想把他推開，說出口的卻是：「幫幫我。」

overwrite.reason: 攻擊念頭觸發身體反應。你的意願沒有變。

c2_verbal.goal: 你不用暴力，也能提出退出要求。
c2_verbal.text:
「我不會推你。請先暫停，讓我決定是否繼續。」
這次，身體沒有阻止你說出口。

c2_defence.goal: 療程會影響你保護自己的能力。
c2_defence.text:
「身體不會先分辨攻擊或自衛。
只要出現攻擊衝動，就會產生反應。」

c2_finalDecision.goal: 你已知道身體會失去一部分自主反應。
c2_finalDecision.text:
你還可以要求退出。
但回到囚室，已經出現的反應不會立即消失。

choices.label: 撤回同意，停止之後的療程
choices.detail: 返回囚室服刑，並接受醫療觀察。
aliases: 撤回同意，停止之後嘅療程
撤回同意，停止之後的療程
Withdraw consent and stop further sessions

choices.label: 完成餘下療程，爭取釋放評估
choices.detail: 你接受繼續制約，換取評估機會，並非即時自由。
aliases: 完成餘下療程，爭取釋放評估
Complete the remaining sessions and seek a release assessment

c2_withdraw.text:
林醫生記錄你撤回同意，把你送回囚室觀察。
你沒有取得釋放資格，也沒有繼續餘下療程。

c2_endWithdraw.goal: 你停止了療程，仍要面對已發生的反應。
c2_endWithdraw.who: 章末結果 ／ 撤回同意
c2_endWithdraw.text:
你保住了之後不再參與的選擇。
身體已經受過的影響，仍然需要跟進。

ending.title: 未完成的改造
paragraphs:
你退出療程，回回囚室，繼續服刑。
只做過一次測試的反胃慢慢退去；醫生仍然安排覆診。

你沒有再坐回那張放映椅。
第一次測試和退出要求，都留在你份醫療紀錄裡。

刑滿之後，你搭巴士離開。收音機播起熟悉的旋律。
你等了一陣，先放鬆扶住座椅那手。

第七日，你終止療程，回回囚室繼續服刑。
但一諗起推開擋路的人，胃仍然會抽緊。

監獄醫生安排跟進，紀錄身體反應。
你沒有再接受放映；已經形成的聯想，卻沒有隨簽名取消。

出獄後，你仍然覆診，學識在衝突前先退開。
你停止了療程，往後的生活仍要跟他留下的反應相處。

c2_complete.text:
第十四日，林醫生把完成報告放在你面前。
主任說，下一步是向外界示範療程成效。

extra.title: 完成報告
extra.label: 看完成報告
extra.text: 攻擊反應降低；仍需公開評估。音樂及自衛能力的影響未獨立處理。

c2_endComplete.goal: 下一步是公開評估，並非已經自由。
c2_endComplete.who: 章末結果 ／ 合格之前
c2_endComplete.text:
主任已經安排好台下的觀眾。
你望着自己的手，不知道他們準備要求你做什麼。

c2_home.goal: 分清楚自己做過的事，和阿健想你替他說的話。
c2_home.text:
你沒有跟他們去。翌晨，新聞報道北郊屋主送院。
阿健傳來訊息，希望你替他證明當晚的去向。

extra.title: 阿健原訊息
extra.label: 打開阿健訊息
extra.text: 「如果有人問，就說昨晚我們一直在奶吧喝東西。幫個忙。」

c2_homeChoice.goal: 分清楚自己做過的事，和阿健想你替他說的話。
c2_homeChoice.text:
「有人問，就說我們整晚都在奶吧。
幫個忙，不要拆穿我。」

choices.label: 拒絕作假，找律師保留原訊息
aliases: 拒絕作假，搵律師保留原訊息
拒絕作假，找律師保留原訊息
Refuse the lie and preserve the messages with a lawyer

choices.label: 約阿健見面，問清楚發生什麼事
aliases: 約阿健見面，問清楚發生咩事
約阿健見面，問清楚發生什麼事
Meet Kin and ask what happened

choices.label: 不回覆，暫時不再聯絡
aliases: 唔回覆，暫時唔再聯絡
不回覆，暫時不再聯絡
Do not reply; suspend contact

c2_escape.goal: 分清楚自己做過的事，和阿健想你替他說的話。
c2_escape.text:
你和阿明從後門離開，沒有傷害屋主。
翌晨，阿健卻叫你說整晚都留在奶吧。

extra.title: 阿健原訊息
extra.label: 打開阿健訊息
extra.text: 「大家都說整晚留在奶吧，才不會互相牽連。記住了。」

c2_escapeChoice.goal: 分清楚自己做過的事，和阿健想你替他說的話。
c2_escapeChoice.text:
「你和我是怎麼離開的，大家都清楚。
他現在卻要我們編另一個故事。」

choices.label: 先找律師，準備面對調查
aliases: 先搵律師，準備面對調查
先找律師，準備面對調查
Consult a lawyer before facing the investigation

choices.label: 見阿健，問他為什麼改口
aliases: 見阿健，問佢點解改口
見阿健，問他為什麼改口
Meet Kin and ask why his story changed

choices.label: 不回覆，斷開聯絡
aliases: 唔回覆，斷開聯絡
不回覆，斷開聯絡
Do not reply; cut contact

c2_meet.goal: 分清楚自己做過的事，和阿健想你替他說的話。
c2_meet.text:
「只要說我們一直在一起，就不會有人再問。
地址出錯已經過去了，何必再追究？」

choices.label: 拿出手機，要求錄音再問地址
aliases: 攞出手機，要求錄音再問地址
拿出手機，要求錄音再問地址
Ask to record the conversation before discussing the address

choices.label: 拒絕作假，結束會面
aliases: 拒絕作假，結束會面
Refuse to lie and end the meeting

choices.label: 答應替他保證整晚在奶吧
aliases: 答應替佢保證整晚喺奶吧
答應替他保證整晚在奶吧
Promise to say he stayed at the milk bar all night

c2_recordKin.goal: 保留完整對話，不把猜測當成事實。
c2_recordKin.text:
你示意要錄音，阿健點頭，壓低聲音。
「沒錯，我沒有查過那間屋。你只要證明奶吧那段，其他別提。」

action.label: 保留完整對話
action.feedback: 地址未核實，和假口供要求，一起留在原對話入面。
action.card:
已保留
地址未核實
要求保證整晚留在奶吧
完整原話，未經剪接

c2_break.goal: 你拒絕替阿健保證去向。
c2_break.text:
「我可以說自己見過的事。
但不會替你編造沒有發生的經過。」

c2_lawyer.goal: 準備按實際經歷接受問話。
c2_lawyer.text:
「訊息保留原檔。你親眼見過什麼，逐項交代。
不知道的不要猜，沒有做過的不要承認。」

extra.title: 問話準備
extra.label: 查看問話準備
extra.text: 保留原訊息，區分親眼所見和他人說法。律師會陪和，案件結果仍須調查。

c2_statement.goal: 只說你親身經歷的部分。
c2_statement.text:
何律師坐在你旁邊。錄音開始。
這次你要回答的，是自己真正做過什麼。

variants.text:
你承認入屋，同時說清楚沒有傷人、怎樣離開。
何律師陪着你；案件不會因為合作就立即消失。

c2_endTruth.goal: 調查繼續，你沒有替阿健作假。
c2_endTruth.who: 章末結果 ／ 自己的版本
c2_endTruth.text:
你沒有保證自己一定無事。
但阿健說的版本，不再是唯一留下的紀錄。

ending.title: 自己的版本
paragraphs:
訊息和阿明的說法印證，你沒有參與那次入屋。
你以證人身份說出阿健的要求，沒有替他作假。

警方亦追查隧道那晚的襲擊。
你為自己做過的事受審；沒有入屋，不代表之前的事沒有發生。

處理完案件和判罰，你離開舊圈子，在車房值夜班。
阿明偶爾會來。阿健沒有再叫過你「大佬」。

你承認入屋，交代怎樣由後門離開。
屋主的證詞亦確認，你撤退時沒有向他動手。

法庭處理入屋和過往襲擊，你仍然要服刑。
阿健想大家一直留在奶吧的版本，沒有成為定案。

刑滿後，阿明介紹你去車房值夜班。
你將工錢放入銀包，第一次不必等人問：「分多少？」

c2_false.goal: 你接受了不真實的說法。
c2_false.text:
「好。如果有人問，我會說我們整晚都在奶吧。」
阿健終於鬆了一口氣。

c2_falseStatement.goal: 你按承諾作出不真實的口供。
c2_falseStatement.text:
問話時，你按照阿健的說法，聲稱他當晚一直在奶吧。
錄音機把你的每個字都留了下來。

c2_contradiction.goal: 你答應的說法開始被核對。
c2_contradiction.text:
幾天後，警方要求你就口供再解釋。
有人提供的時間，和阿健叫你說的對不上。

c2_endAlibi.who: 章末結果 ／ 多了一個謊言
c2_endAlibi.text:
阿健再傳訊息，問你究竟說了什麼。
你原本只想幫他過關，現在卻連自己也需要解釋。

ending.title: 另一份口供
paragraphs:
警方用奶吧閉路電視和車輛紀錄核對時間。
你話阿健整晚都在那裡，影像卻拍到他早已離開。

阿健改口，話是你叫他這麼說。
你替他留下的假口供，最後成為自己受審的證據。

你因虛假口供受審，最後被判監。阿健沒有替你承擔半句。
囚室門關上那刻，你先明白那聲「幫個忙」有幾重。

c2_silence.text:
你沒有回阿健。訊息由催促，慢慢變成責怪。
幾天後，警方留下聯絡，請你就當晚情況接受問話。

c2_endSilence.goal: 你還未說出自己的經歷。
c2_endSilence.who: 章末結果 ／ 沉默的空位
c2_endSilence.text:
你保留了暫時不回覆的選擇。
但當晚發生過什麼，其他人已經開始代你說。

ending.title: 沒有回覆
paragraphs:
你沒有回阿健，但幾天後仍然要面對警方問話。
他將失敗推給你；阿明提供的記錄，令事情逐步還原。

你沒有替阿健作假，亦沒有因沉默就自動變成主謀。
調查之後，你仍然要為已證實的襲擊和搶劫承擔後果。

處理完案件和判罰，你搬走，換了電話號碼。
舊手機留在抽屜。四個人那張桌，再沒有坐齊過。

你切斷聯絡，調查卻沒有停。阿健聲稱入屋是你的安排。
何律師陪你交代去向，阿明亦提供後門接應的記錄。

證據分清楚各人做過的事。你因入屋和過往襲擊服刑。
你沒有傷害屋主，亦沒有為阿健多加一份假口供。

刑滿後，你搬離舊區。阿健再找你時，只收到停用提示。
四個人那張桌，再沒有坐齊過。

c3_wait.goal: 完成釋放評估，同時說清楚療程的代價。
c3_wait.text:
布幕外面有人測試麥克風。
林醫生說，今天會有人故意激怒你。

variants.text:
布幕外面有人測試麥克風。你帶住先前寫下的停止安排。
林醫生這次先將評估規則交給你。

c3_before.goal: 完成釋放評估，同時說清楚療程的代價。
c3_before.text:
「我們需要記錄你的反應。
如果需要停止，你仍然可以開口。」

choices.label: 先問清楚測試界線
choices.detail: 確認停止要求會點處理。
aliases: 先問清楚測試界線
Ask about the test's limits first

choices.label: 要求記錄音樂和自衛問題
choices.detail: 不給「完成療程」掩蓋副作用。
aliases: 要求記錄音樂同自衛問題
要求記錄音樂和自衛問題
Have the music and self-defence problems recorded

choices.label: 直接上台，先完成評估
choices.detail: 你暫時不提出額外要求。
aliases: 直接上台，先完成評估
Go on stage and begin the assessment

c3_limits.goal: 完成釋放評估，同時說清楚療程的代價。
c3_limits.text:
「演員只能推你一下。你要求停止，就必須暫停。」
你請她寫下來，而不只是口頭承諾。

action.label: 核對測試安排
action.feedback: 測試界線、停止要求和觀察反應，已加入評估表。
action.card:
評估安排
一次挑釁測試
可口頭要求停止
停止要求亦須記錄

c3_sideEffects.goal: 完成釋放評估，同時說清楚療程的代價。
c3_sideEffects.text:
「我無法推開別人，連聽音樂都會反胃。
報告只說我不再打人，有沒有把這些也寫進去？」

c3_doctorReply.goal: 完成釋放評估，同時說清楚療程的代價。
c3_doctorReply.text:
她停下筆。「有。這些不應在台上被略過。」
你看着她把補充頁重新夾入文件。

c3_step.goal: 完成釋放評估，同時說清楚療程的代價。
c3_step.text:
燈一着，台下突然安靜。
演員走過來，推了你一下。你抬手，胃立即收緊。

c3_stageChoice.goal: 完成釋放評估，同時說清楚療程的代價。
c3_stageChoice.text:
「這樣就不敢還手了？你以前不是很威風嗎？」
主任已轉向台下，準備宣布結果。

choices.label: 要求停止測試，等身體平復
aliases: 要求停止測試，等身體平復
Ask to stop while your body settles

choices.label: 拿起麥克風，說出自己身體的反應
aliases: 攞起咪，講出自己身體嘅反應
拿起麥克風，說出自己身體的反應
Take the microphone and describe what is happening

choices.label: 忍住，等他完成觀察
aliases: 忍住，等佢完成觀察
忍住，等他完成觀察
Endure it until the observation is over

c3_stop.goal: 完成釋放評估，同時說清楚療程的代價。
c3_stop.text:
「停。我不會打他，但現在連站也站不穩。」
林醫生上前，叫演員退開。

variants.text:
你指着核對過的安排：「要求停止，就必須暫停。」
林醫生叫演員退開，把你的要求記錄下來。

c3_stopped.goal: 完成釋放評估，同時說清楚療程的代價。
c3_stopped.text:
台下有人問：他是不想傷人，還是根本無法出手？
主任未答。阿晴把記者證放在台邊。

c3_voice.goal: 完成釋放評估，同時說清楚療程的代價。
c3_voice.text:
你握着麥克風。手在顫抖，但你還能說話。
「沒有出手，不代表我現在安然無恙。」

action.label: 向台下說出反應
action.feedback:
「他可以推我，我連擋開他都會反胃。
評估的時候，請把這句話也寫進去。」

c3_endure.goal: 完成釋放評估，同時說清楚療程的代價。
c3_endure.text:
直到演員退開，你才放鬆抓住椅邊的手。
台下響起掌聲。林醫生望着你，沒有跟着鼓掌。

c3_review.goal: 完成釋放評估，同時說清楚療程的代價。
c3_review.text:
醫療小組另行面談。幾天後，釋放申請獲批。
主任遞來另一張紙：宣傳訪問授權。

c3_releaseChoice.goal: 完成釋放評估，同時說清楚療程的代價。
c3_releaseChoice.text:
「釋放已經批准，再做個訪問，對大家都好。」
林醫生補充：「訪問不是釋放條件。」

choices.label: 先拿完整醫療報告副本，拒絕宣傳
choices.detail: 保留身體反應的書面記錄。
aliases: 先攞完整醫療報告副本，拒絕宣傳
先拿完整醫療報告副本，拒絕宣傳
Request the full medical report and decline publicity

choices.label: 接受簡短訪問，照稿說療程成功
choices.detail: 你的說話會被用作計劃宣傳。
aliases: 接受簡短訪問，照稿講療程成功
接受簡短訪問，照稿說療程成功
Accept an interview and read the success script

choices.label: 不做訪問，按釋放安排離開
choices.detail: 你可以之後再申請病歷副本。
aliases: 唔做訪問，按釋放安排離開
不做訪問，按釋放安排離開
Decline the interview and follow the release arrangements

c3_copy.goal: 完成釋放評估，同時說清楚療程的代價。
c3_copy.text:
你逐頁核對副本，找到「音樂聯想未處理」。
那行字很小，卻沒有被刪掉。

action.label: 收好醫療報告副本
action.feedback: 副本與原報告頁數相同，載有醫生簽名。
action.card:
完成報告副本
攻擊意念伴隨噁心
自衛能力受影響
音樂聯想未獨立處理

c3_script.goal: 完成釋放評估，同時說清楚療程的代價。
c3_script.text:
「療程幫助我重新開始。」
你照稿讀完。攝影機關閉，胃部仍然沒有放鬆。

c3_noPress.goal: 完成釋放評估，同時說清楚療程的代價。
c3_noPress.text:
主任收起授權紙。沒有人拍掌送你。
但放行那道門，照樣打開。

c3_depart.goal: 完成釋放評估，同時說清楚療程的代價。
c3_depart.text:
職員交還你的衣物，以及一張覆診卡。
你走出門口，沒有人再指示你下一步該怎麼做。

extra.title: 釋放與覆診安排
extra.label: 查看覆診卡
extra.text: 按時報到及覆診。宣傳訪問另行自願；不接受訪問不撤銷已批安排。

c3_end.text:
你獲准有條件離開監獄，身體的制約卻仍在。
第一個想回去的地方，是家。

c4_home.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_home.text:
你嘗試開門，鎖芯卻已經換了。
一名陌生租客說，家人搬走前沒有留下新地址。

c4_homeChoice.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_homeChoice.text:
袋裡只有少量現金，以及一張覆診卡。
你要先去哪裡？

choices.label: 打電話給阿明，問他可不可以見面
aliases: 打畀阿明，問佢可唔可以見面
打電話給阿明，問他可不可以見面
Call Ming and ask to meet

choices.label: 去舊奶吧附近，找熟悉的人
aliases: 去舊奶吧附近，搵熟悉嘅人
去舊奶吧附近，找熟悉的人
Look for familiar people near the old milk bar

choices.label: 照覆診卡地址，去社區支援站
aliases: 照覆診卡地址，去社區支援站
Go to the support centre listed on your card

c4_ming.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_ming.text:
「那晚我開車走了，沒有回頭。
我不會叫你當作沒事。但今晚，我可以先替你找個住處。」

variants.text:
「那晚我在後門等，後來看見警察把你帶走。
我沒有去解釋。這件事，我一直沒有說出口。」

c4_mingReply.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_mingReply.text:
你接過那一杯水，沒有說原諒他。
阿明帶你到附近的支援站，表示會留下等你。

c4_underpass.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_underpass.text:
隧道裡，老人一見到你就退後。
「是他。」旁邊一個男人擋住你去路。

variants.text:
老人認出你，緊握拐杖。「你後來把他拉開了，
但他們搶我銀包的時候，你也在場。」

老人一看見你便喊：「那個叫我廢物的人！」
幾名途人停下。你突然不知道雙手可以放在哪裡。

c4_elderChoice.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_elderChoice.text:
你想擋開伸過來的手，胃部立即抽緊。
你仍然可以說話，也仍然可以走開。

choices.label: 承認傷害過他，請旁人幫忙隔開
choices.detail: 道歉不代表對方必須原諒你。
aliases: 承認傷害過佢，請旁人幫忙隔開
承認傷害過他，請旁人幫忙隔開
Acknowledge hurting him and ask someone to separate you

choices.label: 不爭辯，退向有燈的店舖
choices.detail: 先離開眼前衝突。
aliases: 唔爭辯，退向有燈嘅店舖
不爭辯，退向有燈的店舖
Do not argue; retreat towards a lit shop

c4_apologise.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_apologise.text:
「是我。我做過，對不起。
但請你們不要動手。」店員走出來，把雙方隔開。

c4_retreat.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_retreat.text:
你撞到牆邊，擦傷了膝蓋。店員叫你站到燈下。
一輛巡邏車慢慢停下。

c4_patrol.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_patrol.text:
車門打開，走下來的是阿健和阿東。
阿健看見你，先笑了笑，再把制服扣好。

c4_badge.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_badge.text:
「真巧，大佬。上車，我們送你一程。」
你望向他胸前的證件，以及車門上的標記。

action.label: 看清證件和車號
action.feedback:
街區外判巡邏員，不是警察。
你記下車號，亦記得附近店舖個名。
action.card:
街區外判巡邏
阿健與阿東：受僱巡邏員
並非警察
車號與地點已記錄

c4_patrolChoice.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_patrolChoice.text:
「怎麼？現在不認得我們了？」
他擋着車門，等你走近。

choices.label: 留在店門口，請店員幫忙聯絡支援站
choices.detail: 不跟他們去沒有旁人的地方。
aliases: 留喺店門口，請店員幫忙聯絡支援站
留在店門口，請店員幫忙聯絡支援站
Stay by the shop and ask staff to call the support centre

choices.label: 當面打電話給阿明，說出位置
choices.detail: 令其他人知道你在邊。
aliases: 當面打畀阿明，講出位置
當面打電話給阿明，說出位置
Call Ming in front of them and state your location

choices.label: 上車，信他們一次
choices.detail: 車上只有你跟他們。
aliases: 上車，信佢哋一次
上車，信他們一次
Get in and trust them once more

c4_public.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_public.text:
店員沒有走開。阿健見有人看着，收起笑容。
支援站社工接通電話，叫你等他安排接送。

c4_call.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_call.text:
「不要上車，我現在就過來。」
你大聲說出店名。阿東放下擋在車門的手。

c4_ride.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_ride.text:
車沒有朝你所說的地址行駛。
阿東把你的袋子扔到腳邊，問以前為什麼要聽你的話。

c4_road.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_road.text:
他們把你推下車，拿走外套。你抬手，仍然無法抵擋。
尾燈消失後，你摸到袋裡的電話。

c4_helpCall.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_helpCall.text:
你報出路牌和車號，請人安排救護。
接線員叫你留在有燈的地方。

action.label: 傳出位置，等候救護
action.feedback:
救護人員接到位置，將你送往醫療中心。
你的衣物、擦傷和說法都有記錄。

c4_support.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_support.text:
「住宿和醫療可以先安排。
有位跟進療程的記者想見你，你可以拒絕。」

c4_supportChoice.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_supportChoice.text:
社工把醫療轉介和記者的聯絡方式放在桌上。
你想先處理哪一件事？

choices.label: 先接受獨立醫療評估
choices.detail: 暫時不接受訪問，求醫照常安排。
aliases: 先接受獨立醫療評估
Get an independent medical assessment first

choices.label: 見記者，說清楚療程之後發生的事
choices.detail: 接受訪問前，可以訂明使用影像的界線。
aliases: 見記者，講清楚療程之後發生嘅事
見記者，說清楚療程之後發生的事
Meet the reporter and describe life after treatment

c4_clinic.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_clinic.text:
呂醫生先檢查你的身體，再詢問療程經過。
她說：「你不必先上鏡，我才可以幫你。」

c4_reporter.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_reporter.text:
「我會保留原檔。資助人想用影片宣傳，
但你可以先看，也可以拒絕回答。」

c4_soundChoice.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_soundChoice.text:
桌邊有一部播放器，裡面是療程資料片。
阿晴問，可不可以用來核對經過？

choices.label: 先靜音，只看畫面
choices.detail: 不用自己身體再次測試配樂的影響。
aliases: 先靜音，只睇畫面
先靜音，只看畫面
Mute it and view only the images

choices.label: 照常播放，邊看邊說
choices.detail: 片段可能包含療程配樂。
aliases: 照常播放，邊睇邊講
照常播放，邊看邊說
Play it normally and talk through it

c4_silent.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_silent.text:
阿晴拔掉喇叭線。你指着畫面，交代首次反胃的時間。
訪問記錄你承認過往傷人，也記錄療程之後的反應。

c4_play.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_play.text:
熟悉的音符響起，胃部突然收緊。
阿晴發現你緊握桌邊，立即伸手關機。

variants.text:
你提起早已向醫生反映配樂問題。
阿晴立即拔掉喇叭線：「那就不應該再播。」

c4_cut.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_cut.text:
你指着電源，示意不要再播。
訪問暫停，阿晴問要不要安排醫生。

action.label: 確認播放器已關閉
action.feedback:
播放器已關閉，這次播放安排亦有記錄。
阿晴安排你去醫療中心檢查，不再嘗試播片。

c4_edit.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_edit.text:
資助人何先生帶來宣傳剪輯。
你承認搶劫、傷人那段，全部沒有了。

extra.title: 原訪問與宣傳片
extra.label: 對照兩個版本
extra.text:
原檔：過往罪行、療程、目前反應。
宣傳片：只留療程後不適，刪去你承認傷人的部分。

c4_editChoice.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_editChoice.text:
「觀眾需要一個清楚的受害者，不必知道那麼多背景。」
阿晴把原錄音機留在你面前。

choices.label: 要求保留承認罪行那段，取回完整原檔
choices.detail: 你不接受被包裝成從未傷人的人。
aliases: 要求保留承認罪行嗰段，攞返完整原檔
要求保留承認罪行那段，取回完整原檔
Insist on keeping your admission and obtain the full recording

choices.label: 暫時不授權，先拿文件問律師
choices.detail: 停止發佈安排，保留之後再決定的空間。
aliases: 暫時唔授權，先攞文件問律師
暫時不授權，先拿文件問律師
Withhold permission and take the documents to a solicitor

c4_fullRecord.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_fullRecord.text:
「我做過的，我承認。療程對我做過什麼，也必須交代。」
阿晴複製原檔，註明尚未授權何先生發佈。

c4_hold.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_hold.text:
你要求暫停發佈。阿晴保留原檔，同意先讓律師核對。
何先生說這樣會錯過新聞時機，你沒有改口。

c4_medical.goal: 找一個可以落腳、亦可以求助的地方。
c4_medical.text:
「先處理你目前的反應。
對外怎樣說，不應成為你求醫的條件。」

c4_end.goal: 你已經找到醫療與住宿支援。
c4_end.text:
社工替你約了何律師。
同一天早上，主任也打電話來，想談一份「重新開始」的安排。

c5_room.goal: 先看清條件，再決定自己的經歷交給誰。
c5_room.text:
「好消息是你暫時穩定了。
後續治療需要時間，不是再拍一段影片就代表康復。」

c5_lawyer.goal: 先看清條件，再決定自己的經歷交給誰。
c5_lawyer.text:
「你可以申訴，也可以暫時不公開。
但請看清楚，有沒有人要求你簽署不實的聲明。」

c5_offer.goal: 先看清條件，再決定自己的經歷交給誰。
c5_offer.text:
「有賠償、有覆診，還有一份宣傳工作。
大家不要再追究，一起向前看。」

variants.text:
「上次訪問的反應很好，我們可以繼續合作。
有賠償，也有一份長期宣傳工作。」

c5_terms.goal: 先看清條件，再決定自己的經歷交給誰。
c5_terms.text:
你翻到聲明那頁：
「目前不適與療程無關。」醫療記錄並沒有得出這個結論。

action.label: 看清賠償與聲明條款
action.feedback:
賠償與宣傳工作綁定對外聲明及保密要求。
你可以不接受；求醫和申訴會另外安排。
action.card:
自願和解提議
賠償＋宣傳工作
要求聲明不適與療程無關
另有對外談論限制

c5_dossier.goal: 先看清條件，再決定自己的經歷交給誰。
c5_dossier.text:
何律師將文件分成三疊。
先分清楚手上有什麼，再決定要交去哪裡。

hotspots.label: 醫療紀錄
hotspots.title: 醫療紀錄
hotspots.text: 你沒有即場拿副本。律師可以申請原檔，現有覆診紀錄會先保存。

variants.text: 你保留的副本載有醫生簽名，和「音樂聯想未處理」那行字。可以連和現時反應交給獨立醫生核對。

hotspots.label: 街頭遭遇
hotspots.title: 街頭遭遇
hotspots.text: 這次你沒有遇到巡邏員。不會將其他人的傳聞當成你親眼見過的事。

variants.text: 你記下阿健、阿東和車號；救護記錄亦有接到你的地點。律師會另行投訴，不自行推定上級有指使。
你認出阿健、阿東，並記下車號與地點。你沒有上車，亦不會聲稱發生過沒有親歷的襲擊。

hotspots.label: 完整原話
hotspots.title: 完整原話
hotspots.text: 你沒有接受後來的訪問。律師會先申請公開評估錄音，再由你核對自己說過的話。

variants.text: 阿晴提供的原檔包括你承認傷人，和療程後的反應。宣傳版刪走了前半段，兩份要分開保存。
訪問仍未授權發佈，原檔由阿晴保留。律師可以先核對，再由你決定公開範圍。

c5_finalChoice.goal: 先看清條件，再決定自己的經歷交給誰。
c5_finalChoice.text:
「我會解釋每個選擇的後果。
但簽名前，你有權爭取時間，也有權保留自己的說法。」

choices.label: 接受主任條件，換取賠償和宣傳工作
choices.detail: 簽下與現有醫療證據不符的聲明。
aliases: 接受主任條件，換取賠償同宣傳工作
接受主任條件，換取賠償和宣傳工作
Accept compensation and publicity work on the administrator's terms

choices.label: 公開完整證詞，連自己做過的事一起說
choices.detail: 由律師核對事實；你的罪行亦會重新被討論。
aliases: 公開完整證詞，連自己做過嘅事一齊講
公開完整證詞，連自己做過的事一起說
Give your full account publicly, including your own offences

choices.label: 不上鏡，向獨立機構正式申訴
choices.detail: 交文件、接受調查，同時繼續醫療跟進。
aliases: 唔上鏡，向獨立機構正式申訴
不上鏡，向獨立機構正式申訴
Stay off camera and make an independent formal complaint

choices.label: 接受何先生剪輯，成為反療程宣傳人物
choices.detail: 以刪走過往罪行的版本換取平台和收入。
aliases: 接受何先生剪輯，成為反療程宣傳人物
Accept Mr Ho's edit and become an anti-treatment campaign figure

choices.label: 暫時不替任何人宣傳，先照顧自己
choices.detail: 拒絕兩邊提議，保留文件，繼續覆診及報到。
aliases: 暫時唔替任何人宣傳，先照顧自己
暫時不替任何人宣傳，先照顧自己
Decline both publicity offers and focus on living

c5_state.goal: 先看清條件，再決定自己的經歷交給誰。
c5_state.text:
你在聲明簽名。主任將另一份工作安排推過來。
下一次見面，會有化妝師和攝影機。

c5_public.goal: 先看清條件，再決定自己的經歷交給誰。
c5_public.text:
錄音開始。你先說隧道那晚，再說入屋和療程。
這次沒有人可以只留下自己想要那半段。

c5_private.goal: 先看清條件，再決定自己的經歷交給誰。
c5_private.text:
何律師交出申訴。缺少的原檔逐一申請，不用猜測補。
你接過收件編號，先去下一次覆診。

c5_campaign.goal: 先看清條件，再決定自己的經歷交給誰。
c5_campaign.text:
何先生說，你終於懂得把握機會。
阿晴要求你保留原檔，隨後退出這次宣傳。

c5_quiet.goal: 先看清條件，再決定自己的經歷交給誰。
c5_quiet.text:
你拒絕兩份宣傳安排，保留文件。
社工替你找到暫住地方，呂醫生約好下次覆診。

endState.text:
賠償入帳，你有了固定工作。每次錄影，稿紙都一樣：
「我已經康復，療程沒有問題。」

ending.title: 被借走的聲音
paragraphs:
賠償入帳，你有了固定工作。每次錄影，稿紙都一樣：
「我已經康復，療程沒有問題。」

你照常覆診，反應亦有起伏。但聲明限制了你對外說什麼。
記者問起身體，你看向鏡頭旁邊等着你的人。

幾個月後，新廣告播出。畫面裡你笑得好自然。
只有錄影室裡的你知道，那句說話已經重錄了七次。

endPublic.text:
完整證詞公開。療程的風險和公開評估方式，接受獨立調查。
你過往傷人的事，亦再次成為新聞。

ending.title: 留下名字的人
paragraphs:
完整證詞公開。療程的風險和公開評估方式，接受獨立調查。
你過往傷人的事，亦再次成為新聞。

受害者沒有義務原諒你。你配合原有判決與調查，不以療程抵銷罪責。
部分試行安排被暫停，醫療記錄要重新審視。

你繼續覆診，身體未完全恢復。第一次試聽音樂，只播了幾秒。
你自己按停。這次，沒有人等住用這一幕證明什麼。

你公開承認那晚令屋主死亡，再交代療程經過。
屋主家屬拒絕接受你的道歉，你沒有要求他們改口。

療程接受獨立調查，部分安排被暫停。
你的釋放條件和原判記錄照樣存在，那條人命亦不會回來。

你按時報到、覆診，亦配合後續程序。
那份完整證詞留下你個名，同時留下你不能夠推走的責任。

endPrivate.text:
你拒絕兩邊宣傳，向獨立機構提交正式申訴。
由律師分清楚每項指控；沒有文件支持的部分，先列為待核實。

ending.title: 不替任何人說話
paragraphs:
你拒絕兩邊宣傳，向獨立機構提交正式申訴。
由律師分清楚每項指控；沒有文件支持的部分，先列為待核實。

過程比新聞慢。你接受問話、補交紀錄，繼續報到和覆診。
有一些申訴獲得跟進，有一些仍然未有定論。

你找到一份車房工作，租了一間細房。
信箱再有來信時，你會自己拆開，看完先決定點回覆。

endCampaign.text:
何先生替你安排訪問和收入。海報只說你遭遇過什麼，沒有說你做過什麼。
第一場集會，台下為你站起身。

ending.title: 換一張椅
paragraphs:
何先生替你安排訪問和收入。海報只說你遭遇過什麼，沒有說你做過什麼。
第一場集會，台下為你站起身。

後來，舊案資料再被翻出。宣傳團隊叫你照稿答，不要提原錄音。
阿晴拒絕交出只剩半段的故事。

你坐在另一間錄影室，對面換了一批人。
稿紙送到手上，仍有人指着一句話：「這句，照着讀。」

endQuiet.text:
你沒有簽宣傳協議，亦暫時不公開作證。文件仍然保留。
覆診、報到、找住處，成為每日要處理的事。

ending.title: 先過自己的生活
paragraphs:
你沒有簽宣傳協議，亦暫時不公開作證。文件仍然保留。
覆診、報到、找住處，成為每日要處理的事。

不再上鏡，不代表往事消失。你仍要面對做過的事，
亦要學識在身體未恢復時，用其他方法求助和保護自己。

某個早晨，你打開唱機，手留在停止鍵旁邊。
你聽了一小段，決定今天到這度。窗外沒有觀眾，亦沒有人拍掌。

takings.title: 昨晚搶到的錢
takings.text: 你們搶到三鎊二十便士。錢太少，連車費都不夠，卻為此恐嚇並傷害一個老人。

broadcast.title: 電視新聞：行為矯正
broadcast.text: 政府將試行行為矯正療程，聲稱能抑制暴力衝動。新聞只提到試行計劃，未交代具體療程。

window.title: 窗後的人影
window.text: 你在後花園看見屋主拿着電話，窗下還有狗。屋主並沒有外出；阿健的說法已被現場情況推翻。

plan.title: 阿健的計劃
plan.text: 目標：北郊一間獨立屋。阿健聲稱屋主外出，屋內有值錢的收藏。消息未經核實。

front.title: 前門接應
front.text: 你接受阿健的安排：自己由側窗進入，其他人在前門等候。沒有人查看後門。

checked.title: 阿明核實的情況
checked.text: 屋內有人，也有狗。後花園通往另一路；阿明願意留在那邊接應。阿健的消息並不準確。

occupied.title: 屋主就在屋內
occupied.text: 屋主發現你，已經報警。這次入屋並不是阿健所說的無人目標。

alarm.title: 警報已經啟動
alarm.text: 電話筒未放好，門上的警報燈亮着。屋主表示警察正在趕來。

tunnelClip.title: 隧道的錄影片段
tunnelClip.text: 路人拍下了當晚的一部分經過並上傳。鏡頭只記錄了其中一段，不能當成整晚的完整紀錄。

fatalCase.title: 你的判決
fatalCase.text: 屋主傷重不治，你因致命暴力被判十四年。現已服刑兩年，餘下刑期沒有因參加試行計劃自動取消。

minorCase.title: 入屋案的後續
minorCase.text: 你沒有傷害屋主，但入屋案及過往襲擊仍要依法處理。審訊後判服刑；這不是十四年命案判決。

doctor.title: 林醫生
doctor.text: 她負責行為矯正療程。她說療程讓身體對攻擊衝動產生排斥，並不直接消除憤怒。

terms.title: 療程條款
terms.text: 十四天藥物及視覺刺激。完成後另行評估提前釋放，簽名不等於獲釋。可提出退出，須由醫生面談及書面記錄；退出不會消除原判刑期。

exitRecord.title: 已記錄的退出安排
exitRecord.text: 你在簽名前要求林醫生記錄：提出停止後，必須暫停本次測試並安排面談。這份記錄可以用來追問是否真正執行。

firstFilm.title: 第一次放映
firstFilm.text: 注射後觀看暴力影像，出現強烈噁心。片中同時播放古典音樂，並不只是安靜的背景畫面。

music.title: 配樂也進入療程
music.text: 你指出貝多芬與暴力影像同時播放。林醫生承認可能形成額外聯想，但尚未更換配樂。

daySeven.title: 第七日的反應
daySeven.text: 第七日的紀錄將攻擊念頭列為噁心與停頓的觸發因素。這是身體制約，不等於當事人認和；口頭提出要求仍然做得到。

completion.title: 完成報告
completion.text: 十四天療程已完成。報告認為攻擊反應降低；提前釋放仍需公開評估。對音樂和自衛的影響尚未獨立處理。

homeMessage.title: 阿健要求的假口供
homeMessage.text: 阿健要求你聲稱案發當晚與他一直留在奶吧。你當晚沒有入屋；你沒有義務替他的去向作出虛假保證。

escapeMessage.title: 阿健的新說法
escapeMessage.text: 你由後門離開，阿健卻要求大家對警方說整晚都在奶吧。屋內影像和你真正的去向可能與他的版本衝突。

solicitor.title: 何律師
solicitor.text: 她會陪和整理事實及出席問話。她要求保留原訊息，將親眼所見與猜測分開。

geoAdmission.title: 阿健的原話
geoAdmission.text: 他承認地址消息未經核實，又要求你為整晚都在奶吧的說法作證。你保留了這段原話，未經剪接。

alibi.title: 你答應的說法
alibi.text: 你答應替阿健保證案發時一直在奶吧。這個承諾不是當晚真相；其後會與警方取得的資料核對。

stagePlan.title: 公開評估安排
stagePlan.text: 以演員挑釁測試攻擊反應；評估不是授權對方任意傷害你。你可以口頭要求停止，並要求把反應寫入報告。

stageRecord.title: 評估中的停止要求
stageRecord.text: 你在公開場合提出停止。要求和當時反應均有錄音；這與身體無法出手是兩件不同的事。

reporter.title: 阿晴的聯絡
reporter.text: 採訪療程的記者。她留下直接聯絡方法，表示可以提供完整錄音；接受採訪不等於同意任何人使用你的病歷。

releaseCopy.title: 完成報告副本
releaseCopy.text: 你要求並取得副本。報告註明攻擊意念伴隨噁心，亦記錄音樂聯想未被獨立處理；不能用「再無暴力」取代所有健康評估。

releaseLicence.title: 有條件釋放
releaseLicence.text: 特別評估後獲批有條件釋放，須按時報到和覆診；原判記錄仍在。接受宣傳訪問不屬於釋放條件。

mingReturn.title: 阿明的承認
mingReturn.text: 阿明承認沒有替你承擔當晚的後果。他留下車房及社區支援站地址；這次能否接受幫助，與是否原諒他分開。

patrol.title: 外判巡邏證件
patrol.text: 阿健、阿東是外判街區巡邏員，並非警察。他們出示證件不代表有權強行帶你離開；車號和當時地點可供核實。

support.title: 社區支援站
support.text: 值班社工可以安排臨時住宿、醫療轉介和法律聯絡。求醫不需要先接受記者或政府訪問。

interview.title: 採訪授權
interview.text: 阿晴同意先確認聲音和影像。資助訪問的何先生另有宣傳目的；他提供的剪輯不等於記者保留的完整原檔。

editedClip.title: 被刪走的前半段
editedClip.text: 何先生的宣傳片刪走你承認襲擊與搶劫的部分，只保留療程後的不適。這會令人誤以為你從未傷害過人。

incident.title: 身體反應紀錄
incident.text: 醫療人員記錄目前的噁心、無法自衛及聲音誘發反應。需要獨立評估，不能靠一次表演證明治癒或完全失效。

settlement.title: 政府的和解條款
settlement.text: 提出賠償與宣傳工作，要求簽署「不適與療程無關」的聲明及限制對外談論。醫療照顧和法定申訴不以接受此和解為前提。

evidenceMedical.title: 資料：醫療紀錄
evidenceMedical.text: 先核對你手上的報告與覆診紀錄。缺少副本可由律師申請調取，未取得的文件不能當成已證實的證據。

evidencePatrol.title: 資料：街頭遭遇
evidencePatrol.text: 只提交親眼見到的人、車號和地點。外判巡邏員的行為與療程責任需要分開調查，不能自行推定上級指使。

evidenceVoice.title: 資料：完整原話
evidenceVoice.text: 比對完整錄音和宣傳剪輯。親身經歷、文件內容和他人推測分開整理；保留承認過往罪行的部分。

independent.title: 獨立醫療與法律協助
independent.text: 呂醫生跟進身體反應，何律師處理文件與申訴。你可以先求醫，再決定是否公開作證；他們不保證立即康復或案件勝訴。

people.name: 阿朗｜你
people.text: 20歲，阿健、阿東和阿明口中的大佬。四人經常一和行劫、恐嚇路人；最近，阿健開始不滿每次分到的錢。

people.name: 阿健｜物色目標
people.text: 平時找目標和收消息。嫌之前搶到的錢太少，這次帶了一個入屋計劃。

people.name: 阿東｜動手打人
people.text: 負責恐嚇和動手，脾氣最差。嫌自己出力打人，最後卻分不到多少錢。

people.name: 阿明｜開車接應
people.text: 負責開車和接應。他最關心在哪裡等、出事點走，不想臨時先找退路。

people.name: 林醫生｜療程醫生
people.text: 負責行為矯正評估，認為身體排斥暴力就能減少傷害。你要分清楚她說的效果和你真正願意接受的代價。

people.name: 何律師｜協助處理問話
people.text: 協助你整理親眼所見和現有資料，不會替你編造口供，亦不保證案件結果。

people.name: 阿晴｜記者
people.text: 跟進行為矯正計劃的記者。願意留下完整訪問，但與出錢宣傳的何先生有不同立場。

people.name: 何先生｜宣傳計劃資助人
people.text: 反對政府療程，想用你的遭遇製作宣傳。他想要的受害者形象，未必容得下你完整的經歷。

people.name: 呂醫生｜獨立醫生
people.text: 跟進療程後的身體反應，拒絕用政治聲明代替診斷。不承諾一次治療就能恢復。

cold0.goal: You are Long. Kin, Tung and Ming call you their leader.
cold0.text:
You have just taken the old man's wallet when footsteps scrape at the far end of the tunnel.
Tung still has his foot on the cane. Ming watches the exit. “Someone's coming back.”

cold1.goal: You have the money. Stop him, or let the intimidation continue?
cold1.text:
A white beam sweeps across the wall, then goes dark.
The old man cries out. “Help! There's someone—”

choices.label: Pull Tung away and tell him to stop
aliases: 拉開阿東，叫佢停手
拉開阿東，叫他停手
Pull Tung away and tell him to stop

choices.label: Wave the wallet and humiliate the man yourself
aliases: 晃一晃銀包，親自羞辱老人
Wave the wallet and humiliate the man yourself

choices.label: Step aside and let Tung continue
aliases: 企開，任由阿東繼續
站開，任由阿東繼續
Step aside and let Tung continue

coldStop.goal: You put a stop to the intimidation.
coldStop.text:
You pull Tung away. The cane clatters, its echo running down the tunnel.
The figure at the exit stays. The white light comes on again.

coldMock.goal: You threaten the old man yourself.
coldMock.text:
“Look at yourself. A piece of rubbish.
Lift your head. I'm talking to you.”

coldWatch.text:
You do not stop him. Coins roll against your shoes before Tung finally backs off.
Ming is watching the exit. “That person hasn't stopped looking at us.”

coldWitness.goal: Get a clear look at the figure by the exit.
coldWitness.text:
The stranger raises a phone, its camera fixed on you.
He does not approach. He takes another step towards the light.

choices.label: Chase him to the exit and demand the phone
aliases: 追到出口，逼他放下電話
Chase him to the exit and demand the phone

choices.label: Step back with open hands and tell Tung to stop
aliases: 攤開雙手退後，叫阿東收手
Step back with open hands and tell Tung to stop

choices.label: Take everyone away without approaching him
aliases: 立即帶人離開，不再理會他
Take everyone away without approaching him

coldChase.goal: The stranger is heading for a brightly lit shop.
coldChase.text:
As you follow, he shouts, “They're robbing someone!”
People turn inside the shop. Ming grabs you and drags you back into the dark.

coldBackOff.goal: You have stopped. The camera has not.
coldBackOff.text:
You step back with open hands. Tung swears at you; the old man grips his cane.
The stranger keeps filming until you leave.

coldLeave.text:
You tell everyone to go. Nobody runs, but the footsteps quicken.
Before you turn the corner, the phone tilts towards your parked car.

coldWallet.goal: Find out how much money you took.
coldWallet.text:
Only when the car door shuts do you notice the wallet still in your hand.
How much was all that risk worth?

action.label: Open the wallet
action.feedback:
Three pounds and twenty pence.
Kin counts the coins and slaps them into your hand. “Split what, exactly?”

world.goal: Hear Kin's plan before deciding whether to go.
world.text:
The next evening, you tip £3.20 onto the milk-bar table.
Kin stares at it. “All that trouble for this?”

variants.text:
At the milk bar the next evening, Tung sits down and glares at you.
“You rob him, then pull me off him? When did you get so soft?”

At the milk bar, Kin slides the coins back to you.
“We waited while you played with that old man. This is our share?”

Ming brings up last night as soon as he sits down.
“We nearly drew a patrol car. This time, agree on a way out first.”

extra.label: Watch the news (optional)
extra.text: TV news: “The government will trial a behaviour-conditioning programme intended to suppress violent impulses.”

worldRisk.goal: Hear Kin's plan before deciding whether to go.
worldRisk.text:
Kin slides his phone across the table. Last night's footage is already online.
You reach to enlarge it. He switches off the screen.

extra.title: The tunnel footage
extra.label: Look at the footage on the phone
extra.text: The clip begins with the wallet already in your hand. It does not show what happened before the robbery. The witness has uploaded it.

variants.text: Your face fills the frame as you chase the witness. The clip ends when he reaches the shop.
The clip shows you backing away and telling Tung to stop. That does not erase the robbery and threats before it.
The clip follows your departure, ending on the back of the car. Only part of the number plate is visible.

offer0.goal: Hear Kin's plan before deciding whether to go.
offer0.text:
“There's a detached house in the northern suburbs. Valuable collections inside.
I'm told the owner's away. Enough in it for all of us.”

paper.goal: Hear Kin's plan before deciding whether to go.
paper.text:
Kin pushes an address towards you.
Ming asks, “Where do I wait? Which way do we leave if it goes wrong?”

action.label: Read the address
action.feedback:
The address is clear.
The owner being away is only hearsay. Nobody has arranged an escape route.

planChoice.goal: Hear Kin's plan before deciding whether to go.

choices.label: Check the house with Ming and arrange a rear exit
choices.detail: It takes time, and tells Kin you do not trust his information.
aliases: 同阿明先核實消息，再安排後門接應
和阿明先核實消息，再安排後門接應
Check the house with Ming and arrange a rear exit

choices.label: Accept Kin's plan and put him at the front door
choices.detail: The information remains unverified. You are trusting Kin with your escape.
aliases: 接受阿健計劃，由佢帶人守前門
接受阿健計劃，由他帶人守前門
Accept Kin's plan and put him at the front door

choices.label: Call it off and tell everyone to leave
choices.detail: You can stop your part in this. Your companions may not follow you.
aliases: 今晚唔做，叫大家散
今晚不做，叫大家散
Call it off and tell everyone to leave

check0.goal: Check who is home and where help will wait before entering.
check0.text:
You and Ming stop on the wet grass behind the house.
An upstairs curtain moves. Kin said the owner was away.

action.label: Look at the figure behind the curtain
action.feedback:
The curtain shifts. A woman holding a telephone looks into the garden.
A dog barks at a downstairs window. Someone is home.

check1.goal: Check who is home and where help will wait before entering.
check1.text:
“She hasn't gone anywhere.
There's a path behind the garden. I can wait there. Are you still going in?”

check2.goal: Check who is home and where help will wait before entering.
check2.text:
“It was what I heard. I wasn't trying to deceive you.
It's one person. Don't make such a fuss.”

checkedEnter.goal: Check who is home and where help will wait before entering.
checkedEnter.text:
You now know the house is occupied.
Continuing means entering despite that knowledge.

choices.label: Cancel the burglary and leave with Ming
choices.detail: You will stay out. Kin and Tung will decide what they do.
aliases: 取消行動，帶阿明離開
Cancel the burglary and leave with Ming

choices.label: Enter through the side window, with Ming at the rear
choices.detail: You intend to steal. Encountering someone may prevent a quiet exit.
aliases: 仍然由側窗入屋，叫阿明留後門接應
Enter through the side window, with Ming at the rear

trust0.goal: Check who is home and where help will wait before entering.
trust0.text:
“You take the side window. Tung and I will hold the front.
Ming stays with the car. Get the valuables, open the door, and go.”

trust1.goal: Check who is home and where help will wait before entering.
trust1.text:
An upstairs light is on when you arrive.
Kin says the owner leaves it on to deter thieves. He has not checked.

trustEnter.goal: Check who is home and where help will wait before entering.
trustEnter.text:
The front is covered. Nobody has checked the rear.
Only Kin's word says the owner is away.

choices.label: Stop here and stay out of the house
choices.detail: You are still outside and can cancel your part in the plan.
aliases: 停手，今晚唔入
停手，今晚不入
Stop here and stay out of the house

choices.label: Follow the plan and climb through the side window
choices.detail: Trust the unverified information and use the front as your escape route.
aliases: 按計劃，由側窗入去
Follow the plan and climb through the side window

enter0.goal: Get out. Decide whether to use force, and which way to go.
enter0.text:
The window frame clicks as your shoe touches the floor.
Kin releases your hand. Outside, the car lights go out.

enter1.goal: Get out. Decide whether to use force, and which way to go.
enter1.text:
Crack.
A plate breaks beneath your shoe. Dog claws scrape across tiles down the hall.

enter2.goal: Get out. Decide whether to use force, and which way to go.
enter2.text:
The claws fall silent. A woman stands at the end of the hall, holding a phone.
She sees your face. The words catch in her throat.

enter3.goal: Get out. Decide whether to use force, and which way to go.
enter3.text:
“Who are you? Help!
Someone's broken in! Help!”

enter4.goal: Get out. Decide whether to use force, and which way to go.
enter4.text:
You reach out, trying to quiet her. She thinks you mean to grab her.
Chair legs shriek against the floor as she lifts it and backs towards the door.

enter5.goal: Get out. Decide whether to use force, and which way to go.
enter5.text: “Stay away! I've given them the address. The police are coming!”

enter6.goal: Get out. Decide whether to use force, and which way to go.
enter6.text:
You back into the telephone table. A heavy ornament rocks on its edge.
You steady it, then realise you are holding it.

alarm.goal: Get out. Decide whether to use force, and which way to go.
alarm.text:
The receiver hangs off the table. Someone is still talking.
The woman sees you look at it and cries out again.

action.label: Check the alarm and telephone
action.feedback:
The voice on the line: “Address confirmed. Officers are on their way.”
The alarm light is on. Sirens grow closer.

exitChoice.goal: Get out. Decide whether to use force, and which way to go.
exitChoice.text:
The woman blocks the front door. You call for Kin. No answer comes.
The sirens stop. Right outside. The ornament is still in your hand.

choices.label: Leave her alone and retreat towards the back door
choices.detail: If you arranged it, Ming will be waiting. Otherwise the way is unchecked.
aliases: 唔碰屋主，沿走廊退去後門
不碰屋主，沿走廊退去後門
Leave her alone and retreat towards the back door

choices.label: Swing the ornament to force a way to the front
choices.detail: You choose force. The homeowner could be seriously hurt.
aliases: 揮動擺設逼佢讓路，衝去前門
揮動擺設逼他讓路，衝去前門
Swing the ornament to force a way to the front

choices.label: Put down the ornament and wait with your hands raised
choices.detail: Stop trying to escape and face arrest for breaking in.
aliases: 放低擺設，舉高手等警察
放下擺設，舉高手等警察
Put down the ornament and wait with your hands raised

rearResolve.goal: Get out. Decide whether to use force, and which way to go.
rearResolve.text: You back down the hall towards the rear door.

rear0.goal: Get out. Decide whether to use force, and which way to go.

rear1.goal: Get out. Decide whether to use force, and which way to go.
rear1.text:
You retreat without approaching the woman.
Someone tries the rear handle twice. Ming is still there.

openRear.goal: Open the rear door and leave with Ming.
openRear.text: You grip the bolt. A police car has stopped at the front.

action.label: Open the rear door
action.feedback:
The door opens outwards.
Ming leads you across the garden to another street.

escaped0.text:
You stole nothing. By the time police reach the front door,
you and Ming are at the far end of the path.

escaped1.text:
Kin calls to ask why you never came to the front.
You look at Ming. For once, you do not want to explain yourself to Kin.

endEscape.text:
You arranged help and chose not to strike the homeowner.
Ming staying behind made that escape route real.

blockedRear0.goal: The rear route is blocked. Surrender or return to the front.
blockedRear0.text:
You push outside and run into the garden gate. A chain pulls it short.
You try again. Only metal answers. Nobody is waiting.

blockedRearChoice.goal: The rear route is blocked. Surrender or return to the front.
blockedRearChoice.text:
You never arranged a rear lookout. Ming is still by the car at the front.
An officer calls, “Anyone out the back?”

choices.label: Stay in the garden and raise your hands
choices.detail: The police will take you away. You will not approach the homeowner again.
aliases: 留喺後院，舉高手
留在後院，舉高手
Stay in the garden and raise your hands

choices.label: Return to the front and look for Kin
choices.detail: Go back towards the arriving police to find your promised escape.
aliases: 折返前門，搵阿健接應
折回前門，找阿健接應
Return to the front and look for Kin

violent0.text:
You tell her to move. The ornament swings before she can.
She raises the chair. They collide; a chair leg snaps.

violent1.text:
She falls. You call out again. No reply.
The screams that filled the house stop all at once.

violent2.text:
The telephone keeps asking, “Hello? Can you hear me?”
You look at the fallen ornament, then pull open the front door.

violent3.text:
You call to Kin to get in the car. Tung walks towards you instead.
Something hard hangs from his lowered hand.

front0.goal: You return to the front, looking for help.
front0.text:
Kin is already moving towards the car.
You call after him. Tung turns back instead.

front1.goal: You return to the front, looking for help.
front1.text:
“What do you think we are?
Your shield against the police?”

betray0.text:
You think he has come to pull you up.
Something strikes you. The ground tilts; car doors slam, one after another.

betray1.text:
You cannot get up. Tyres pass in front of your face.
Your hands are pulled behind your back. Kin and Tung never look round.

caughtResolve.text: You are taken to the police station.

endBetrayed.text:
You did not strike the homeowner, but you are arrested for breaking in.
Neither Kin nor Tung kept the promise at the front door.

verdict0.text:
The homeowner dies from her injuries.
You are sentenced to fourteen years.

verdict1.text:
Two years later, someone brings you a treatment consent form.
Two weeks, he says, could make you a new person.

endFourteen.text:
You used violence to force a way out. Your companions left you behind.
The next people offering to arrange your life work for the government.

surrender0.text:
You raise your hands and stay away from the woman.
Officers cuff you and take you out.

surrender1.text:
You still have to answer for entering the house.
At least you have not knocked someone down to get away.

endSurrender.text:
You knew surrender meant arrest and chose it anyway.
You did not escape, or make someone else's injury the price of your freedom.

withdraw0.goal: You call off your part in the plan.
withdraw0.text: “We haven't even checked the information. Not tonight.”

withdraw1.goal: You call off your part in the plan.
withdraw1.text:
Kin pockets the address. Tung follows him out.
Ming stays and asks whether you are going home.

endWithdraw.text:
You never entered the house.
For the first time, Kin and Tung left without waiting for you.

c2_fatal.goal: Understand the release conditions before deciding about treatment.
c2_fatal.text:
Two years of a fourteen-year sentence have passed.
Today, the administrator wants to discuss a “two-week programme”.

extra.title: Sentence summary
extra.label: Read the sentence summary
extra.text: Fourteen years imposed, two served. Joining the trial does not automatically cancel the remaining sentence.

c2_minor.goal: Understand the release conditions before deciding about treatment.
c2_minor.text:
You are imprisoned for the break-in and earlier assaults. Months later,
the administrator brings up a “two-week programme”.

variants.text:
Your surrender was recorded, but you still answer for the break-in.
Months after sentencing, the administrator offers a place on the trial.

extra.title: Case summary
extra.label: Read the case summary
extra.text: You did not strike the homeowner. Your sentence concerns burglary and earlier assaults, not the fourteen-year fatal-assault case.

c2_offer.goal: Understand the release conditions before deciding about treatment.
c2_offer.text:
“Volunteer for two weeks of treatment.
Pass the assessment and you can apply for early release.”

choices.label: Ask about the risks first
choices.detail: Speak to the doctor before signing anything.
aliases: 先問風險，再決定
Ask about the risks first

choices.label: Read the written terms first
choices.detail: Check the treatment, withdrawal process and release conditions.
aliases: 先睇書面條款
先看書面條款
Read the written terms first

choices.label: Refuse and continue serving your sentence
choices.detail: You will not undergo treatment. The original sentence still applies.
aliases: 拒絕，照原判決服刑
Refuse and continue serving your sentence

c2_question.goal: Understand the release conditions before deciding about treatment.
c2_question.text:
“Expect severe nausea. Your body will reject aggressive impulses.
That doesn't remove anger. Read the withdrawal terms carefully.”

c2_terms.goal: Understand the release conditions before deciding about treatment.
c2_terms.text:
Two weeks does not mean freedom is guaranteed in two weeks.
You pull the consent form closer.

action.label: Open the consent form
action.feedback:
Fourteen days of medication and visual stimuli. Release requires a separate assessment.
You may request withdrawal and a medical interview; your sentence remains.
action.card:
Duration: fourteen days
Method: medication and visual stimuli
Release: separately assessed
Withdrawal: medical interview and written record

c2_decide.goal: Understand the release conditions before deciding about treatment.
c2_decide.text:
You can ask questions.
But the signature still has to be yours.

choices.label: Sign up for treatment
choices.detail: Accept the treatment and the stated conditions.
aliases: 簽名參加
Sign up for treatment

choices.label: Have the stopping procedure recorded before signing
choices.detail: Require a pause before any interview about a request to stop.
aliases: 要求寫低停止安排，再簽
要求寫下停止安排，再簽
Have the stopping procedure recorded before signing

choices.label: Do not sign; return to your cell
choices.detail: You will not undergo treatment. The original sentence still applies.
aliases: 唔簽，返回囚室
不簽，回回囚室
Do not sign; return to your cell

c2_sign.goal: Understand the release conditions before deciding about treatment.
c2_sign.text:
You sign. The administrator takes the papers.
Dr Lam opens another door. “We'll begin with the first test.”

c2_record.goal: Understand the release conditions before deciding about treatment.
c2_record.text:
“All right. Request to stop, pause the test, then discuss.”
You wait for her signature before adding yours.

extra.title: The stopping arrangement
extra.label: Read the added note
extra.text: A request to stop must pause the current test before a medical interview. Both you and Dr Lam have signed.

c2_refuse.text:
You push the papers back. The administrator does not argue.
Beyond the door is the same prison corridor.

c2_endRefuse.goal: You keep your decision and face the original sentence.
c2_endRefuse.text:
You have not gained a chance at early release.
This time, nobody has signed consent on your behalf.

ending.title: No Signature
paragraphs:
You do not join the programme or receive early release.
The rest of your sentence passes behind bars.

Kin never visits again.
Ming's last letter contains only a new address.

When your sentence ends, the milk bar is shuttered and its sign removed.
Your next step is yours, but the lost years will not return.

You refuse treatment. Two of your fourteen years have passed.
You serve the remaining twelve without reapplying for the programme.

For years, you wait for Kin to explain himself.
Eventually, you stop waiting even for a letter.

The old milk bar is gone when you leave prison. You stand on the empty site, holding a bag of clothes.
You kept your will. Fourteen years were the cost of that night.

c2_intake.goal: Attend the first test and notice your physical reactions.
c2_intake.text:
“An injection, then a short film.
Use the stop button if you feel unwell. We'll talk.”

c2_projection.goal: Notice the images, music and your body's response.
c2_projection.text:
You sit in the projector's narrow beam.
There is a stop button beside the chair.

action.label: Look at the screen
action.feedback:
Someone is being attacked on screen. Your stomach suddenly tightens.
The music is Beethoven. You used to listen to it alone in the dark.

c2_firstReaction.goal: You can still make a request.

choices.label: Press the stop button
aliases: 按停止掣
按停止鍵
Press the stop button

choices.label: Ask why they are using this music
aliases: 問點解用呢首音樂
問為什麼用這首音樂
Ask why they are using this music

choices.label: Endure it until this test is over
aliases: 忍住，完成今次測試
忍住，完成這次測試
Endure it until this test is over

c2_stop.goal: Wait for the pause, then decide whether to continue.
c2_stop.text:
You press red. The film keeps running. Dr Lam looks at her clipboard.
You repeat yourself. “I said stop.”

variants.text:
You press red and point to the signed procedure.
“Pause first, then discuss. You wrote it down.”

c2_stopReply.text:
“We'll stop this session. You may withdraw and serve your sentence.
Or recover first, then attend the next test.”

choices.label: Withdraw and return to your cell
choices.detail: Treatment will stop. Your sentence continues, with medical follow-up.
aliases: 退出計劃，返回囚室
退出計劃，回回囚室
Withdraw and return to your cell

choices.label: Have this reaction recorded, then continue
choices.detail: Continue treatment with the symptoms and stop request on record.
aliases: 要求記錄今次反應，再繼續
要求記錄這次反應，再繼續
Have this reaction recorded, then continue

c2_music.goal: Ask why the music is making you ill.
c2_music.text:
“The images are the problem. The music isn't.
Why play them together?”

c2_musicReply.goal: You point out that the soundtrack is affecting you too.
c2_musicReply.text:
“The music may become associated with the reaction. I'll record that.
But the film has not been replaced.”

c2_endure.text:
You grip the chair. The film stops, but your hands will not relax.
Dr Lam ticks a box on her clipboard.

c2_day7.goal: Distinguish not wanting to act from being unable to act.
c2_day7.text:
On day seven, a technician waits at the door. Dr Lam watches through glass.
You are still angry. You still want to leave.

extra.title: Today's record
extra.label: Read today's treatment record
extra.text: Day seven: anger can still be expressed. Aggressive movements now produce nausea and hesitation.

c2_day7Choice.goal: The door is unlocked. You want to leave.

choices.label: Push past him and leave
aliases: 推開佢，自己行出去
推開他，自己走出去
Push past him and leave

choices.label: Keep your hands down and ask for a pause
aliases: 唔動手，要求先停低
不動手，要求先停下
Keep your hands down and ask for a pause

choices.label: Ask whether this also affects self-defence
aliases: 問：連自衛都會咁？
問：連自衛都會這麼？
Ask whether this also affects self-defence

c2_blocked.goal: You still want to leave, but your body stops first.
c2_blocked.text:
You raise your hand. Your stomach clenches; your fingers stop in mid-air.
You mean to push past him. What comes out is, “Help me.”

overwrite.to: Lower your hand and ask the doctor for help
overwrite.reason: The aggressive thought triggers a physical reaction. Your intention has not changed.

c2_verbal.goal: You can request withdrawal without using force.
c2_verbal.text:
“I won't push you. Please pause. Let me decide whether to continue.”
This time, your body does not stop the words.

c2_defence.goal: The conditioning affects your ability to protect yourself.
c2_defence.text:
“Your body won't first distinguish attack from self-defence.
The aggressive impulse itself triggers the response.”

c2_finalDecision.goal: You now understand that some physical responses are no longer voluntary.
c2_finalDecision.text:
You can still request withdrawal.
But returning to your cell will not instantly erase the reactions already learned.

choices.label: Withdraw consent and stop further sessions
choices.detail: Return to your cell, continue your sentence and receive medical observation.
aliases: 撤回同意，停止之後嘅療程
撤回同意，停止之後的療程
Withdraw consent and stop further sessions

choices.label: Complete the remaining sessions and seek a release assessment
choices.detail: Continue conditioning for a chance at assessment, without guaranteed release.
aliases: 完成餘下療程，爭取釋放評估
Complete the remaining sessions and seek a release assessment

c2_withdraw.goal: Withdrawal does not cancel the original sentence.
c2_withdraw.text:
Dr Lam records your withdrawal and returns you to your cell for observation.
You gain no release approval and attend no further sessions.

c2_endWithdraw.goal: Treatment has stopped. Its existing effects still need attention.
c2_endWithdraw.text:
You have stopped further participation.
The effects of what you already underwent still require follow-up.

ending.title: An Unfinished Cure
paragraphs:
You withdraw and return to prison.
The nausea from one session gradually eases. Medical follow-up continues.

You never sit in the screening chair again.
That first test and your withdrawal remain in your medical file.

When your sentence ends, you leave on a bus. A familiar melody plays on the radio.

The prison doctor monitors your reactions.
No more films are shown. The learned associations do not vanish with a signature.

After prison, you keep attending appointments and learn to step away from conflict.
You ended the treatment. You still live with what it left behind.

Ms Ho sits beside you. Recording begins.

ending.title: Your Own Account
paragraphs:
The messages and Ming's account support that you did not join the break-in.
You describe Kin's request as a witness rather than repeat his lie.

Police also investigate the tunnel assault.
You stand trial for your own actions. Staying out of the house does not erase them.

After the proceedings and penalties, you leave the old circle and work nights at a garage.
Ming visits sometimes. Kin never calls you his leader again.

You admit entering and explain the rear escape.
The homeowner confirms that you did not strike her as you withdrew.

You serve a sentence for burglary and earlier assaults.
Kin's all-night milk-bar story does not become the accepted account.

After prison, Ming finds you night work at a garage.
You put your wages in your wallet. For once, nobody asks how to split them.

c2_contradiction.text:
Days later, police ask you to explain your statement again.
Another account does not match the times Kin told you to give.

c2_endAlibi.text:
Kin messages again, demanding to know what you said.
You wanted to get him through this. Now you have to explain yourself too.

ending.title: Another Statement
paragraphs:
Police compare milk-bar CCTV with vehicle records.
You said Kin stayed all night. The images show him leaving much earlier.

Kin changes his story and says the lie was your idea.
The statement you made for him becomes evidence against you.

You are tried and imprisoned for the false statement. Kin accepts none of the blame.
When the cell door closes, you understand the weight of that “favour”.

c2_silence.text:
You ignore Kin. His messages turn from demands into accusations.
Days later, police leave a request to interview you about that night.

c2_endSilence.goal: You have not yet given your account.
c2_endSilence.text:
You have chosen not to reply for now.
Other people are already filling the silence with their accounts of that night.

ending.title: No Reply
paragraphs:
You ignore Kin but still face police questions.
He blames you for the failure. Ming's records help reconstruct what happened.

You did not lie for Kin, and silence does not automatically make you the mastermind.
You still answer for the assaults and robbery the evidence establishes.

After the case and its penalties, you move and change your number.
The old phone stays in a drawer. The four of you never share a table again.

You cut contact. The investigation continues. Kin says the burglary was your plan.
Ms Ho helps you give your account; Ming supplies evidence of the rear escape.

The evidence separates each person's actions. You serve time for burglary and earlier assaults.
You neither struck the homeowner nor added a false statement for Kin.

After prison, you leave the old district. Kin's next call reaches a disconnected number.
The four of you never share a table again.

ending.title: A Borrowed Voice
paragraphs:
Compensation arrives. You have a steady job. Every recording uses the same script:
“I'm well again. There was nothing wrong with the treatment.”

You attend your appointments. The symptoms fluctuate. The declaration limits what you can say.
When a reporter asks about your health, you look at the people beside the camera.

Months later, a new advert shows you smiling naturally.
Only you remember that the line took seven recordings.

endPublic.text:
Your full testimony is public. The risks and the public assessment face independent investigation.
Your earlier violence also returns to the news.

ending.title: The Name on the Record
paragraphs:
Your full testimony is public. The risks and the public assessment face independent investigation.
Your earlier violence also returns to the news.

The victims owe you no forgiveness. You comply with the sentence and investigation.
Parts of the trial are suspended for review. Treatment does not cancel your offences.

You keep attending appointments. Recovery is incomplete. You try a few seconds of music.
You press stop yourself. Nobody needs the moment to prove anything.

You publicly admit causing the homeowner's death before describing the treatment.
Her family reject your apology. You do not ask them to reconsider.

The programme is investigated and parts are suspended.
Your release conditions and conviction remain. Her life does not return.

You attend reporting, treatment and further proceedings.
The full account keeps your name, along with the responsibility you cannot discard.

endPrivate.text:
You refuse both publicity roles and submit an independent complaint.
Your solicitor separates each claim and identifies what still needs verification.

ending.title: Speaking for Yourself
paragraphs:
You refuse both publicity roles and submit an independent complaint.
Your solicitor separates each claim and identifies what still needs verification.

The process moves more slowly than the news. You answer questions, supply records and attend appointments.
Some complaints progress. Others remain unresolved.

You find garage work and rent a small room.
When another letter arrives, you open it yourself and decide how to reply.

endCampaign.text:
Mr Ho arranges interviews and income. The posters describe what happened to you, not what you did.
The first crowd rises to applaud.

ending.title: A Different Chair
paragraphs:
Mr Ho arranges interviews and income. The posters describe what happened to you, not what you did.
The first crowd rises to applaud.

Then the old case resurfaces. Your publicity team tells you to follow the script and leave the original recording out.
Ching refuses to release only half a story.

You sit in another studio, facing different people.
A script arrives. Someone still points to a sentence. “That line. Read it.”

endQuiet.text:
You sign neither publicity agreement and give no public testimony for now. The files are safe.
Appointments, reporting and finding a room fill your days.

ending.title: A Life of Your Own
paragraphs:
You sign neither publicity agreement and give no public testimony for now. The files are safe.
Appointments, reporting and finding a room fill your days.

Staying off camera does not erase the past. You still face what you did.
While your body recovers, you learn other ways to ask for help and protect yourself.

One morning, you start the record player with a hand beside the stop switch.
You listen briefly, then decide that is enough. No audience waits outside. No applause.

takings.title: Last night's takings
takings.text: You stole £3.20. It was not enough even for transport, yet you threatened and hurt an old man for it.

broadcast.title: TV news: behaviour conditioning
broadcast.text: The government announces a trial said to suppress violent impulses. The broadcast gives no detailed treatment procedure.

window.title: The figure behind the curtain
window.text: From the garden, you saw the homeowner with a phone and heard a dog. She had not left; Kin's information was disproved.

plan.title: Kin's plan
plan.text: A detached house in the northern suburbs, supposedly empty and containing valuable collections. Kin's information was never verified.

front.title: Help at the front
front.text: You accepted Kin's arrangement: you would enter by a side window while the others waited at the front. Nobody checked the rear.

checked.title: What Ming checked
checked.text: The house is occupied and has a dog. A garden path leads to another street; Ming can wait there. Kin's information was inaccurate.

occupied.title: The homeowner is inside
occupied.text: She discovered you and called the police. The house was not the empty target Kin described.

alarm.title: The alarm is active
alarm.text: The receiver is hanging loose and an alarm light is on. The homeowner says police are coming.

tunnelClip.title: The tunnel recording
tunnelClip.text: A passer-by recorded and uploaded part of the night. The clip is a fragment, not a complete account.

fatalCase.title: Your sentence
fatalCase.text: The homeowner died from your attack. You received fourteen years and have served two. Joining the trial does not automatically cancel the rest.

minorCase.title: After the burglary case
minorCase.text: You did not strike the homeowner, but face burglary and earlier assault charges. You were sentenced; this is not the fourteen-year fatal case.

doctor.title: Dr Lam
doctor.text: Dr Lam oversees conditioning. She says it makes aggressive impulses physically repellent without directly removing anger.

terms.title: Treatment terms
terms.text: Fourteen days of medication and visual stimuli. Completion leads to a separate release assessment. Withdrawal requires a medical interview and a written record; the sentence remains.

exitRecord.title: Your recorded withdrawal procedure
exitRecord.text: Before signing, you required requests to stop to pause the test before discussion. That record lets you question whether the rule was followed.

firstFilm.title: The first screening
firstFilm.text: Violent images after an injection caused severe nausea. Classical music played alongside them; it was part of the exposure too.

music.title: The music is part of it
music.text: You noted Beethoven playing with violent footage. Dr Lam acknowledged additional associations were possible but did not replace the music.

daySeven.title: The day-seven reaction
daySeven.text: Aggressive thoughts now trigger nausea and hesitation. Conditioning is not agreement; you can still make verbal requests.

completion.title: Completion report
completion.text: Fourteen days completed. The report describes reduced aggressive responses, subject to public assessment. Music and self-defence effects remain unresolved.

homeMessage.title: Kin's false-alibi request
homeMessage.text: Kin wants you to say you were with him at the milk bar all night. You stayed out of the house. You need not make a false guarantee about him.

escapeMessage.title: Kin's new account
escapeMessage.text: You escaped by the rear. Kin wants everyone to claim they stayed at the milk bar. Images and your real movements may contradict him.

solicitor.title: Ms Ho · Solicitor
solicitor.text: Ms Ho helps organise facts and attends questioning. She asks for original messages and a clear division between observation and assumption.

geoAdmission.title: Kin's own words
geoAdmission.text: He admitted not checking the address and asked for an all-night alibi. You preserved the complete, unedited conversation.

alibi.title: Your promise
alibi.text: You agreed to give Kin a false all-night alibi. That promise will be compared against the evidence police obtain.

stagePlan.title: Public assessment plan
stagePlan.text: An actor will provoke you. That does not permit unlimited harm. You can verbally request a stop and require your reactions to be recorded.

stageRecord.title: Your request during the assessment
stageRecord.text: You requested a stop in public. Audio records the request and your reaction. Speaking up is distinct from physically being unable to strike.

reporter.title: Ching's contact details
reporter.text: A reporter covering the programme. She offers direct contact and a full recording. An interview does not grant anyone unrestricted access to your medical history.

releaseCopy.title: A copy of the completion report
releaseCopy.text: You obtained a signed copy documenting nausea, impaired self-defence and unresolved music associations. “No more violence” is not a complete health assessment.

releaseLicence.title: Conditional release
releaseLicence.text: Special assessment grants conditional release with reporting and follow-up requirements. The conviction remains. Publicity is not a release condition.

mingReturn.title: Ming's admission
mingReturn.text: Ming admits failing you that night and gives you garage and support-centre details. Accepting help does not require forgiving him.

patrol.title: The patrol identification
patrol.text: Kin and Tung are contracted patrol staff, not police. Their badges do not authorise forcing you into a van. Their vehicle and location can be checked.

support.title: The support centre
support.text: Staff can arrange temporary housing, medical referrals and legal contacts. Care does not require a media or government interview.

interview.title: Interview permission
interview.text: Ching agrees to check sound and footage first. Mr Ho has a separate publicity purpose; his edit is not the original she keeps.

editedClip.title: The deleted first half
editedClip.text: Mr Ho removed your admission of robbery and assault, retaining only treatment-related symptoms. Viewers could wrongly think you had never hurt anyone.

incident.title: The symptom record
incident.text: Clinicians document nausea, difficulty defending yourself and sound-triggered reactions. These need independent assessment, not a single demonstration of success or failure.

settlement.title: The government settlement terms
settlement.text: Compensation and publicity work require a declaration that symptoms are unrelated to treatment and restrict public discussion. Care and formal complaints do not require accepting this offer.

evidenceMedical.title: Evidence: medical records
evidenceMedical.text: Check the report and follow-up notes you actually hold. A solicitor can request missing originals. Unobtained documents are not verified evidence.

evidencePatrol.title: Evidence: the street encounter
evidencePatrol.text: Submit only people, vehicles and places you witnessed. Patrol misconduct and treatment responsibility require separate investigation; do not assume orders from above.

evidenceVoice.title: Evidence: the complete recording
evidenceVoice.text: Compare the original audio and publicity edit. Separate personal experience, documents and other people's theories. Retain your admission of earlier offences.

independent.title: Independent medical and legal help
independent.text: Dr Lui treats your symptoms; Ms Ho handles records and complaints. You can seek care before deciding about publicity. Neither promises instant recovery or a legal victory.

people.name: Long / You
people.text: Twenty. Kin, Tung and Ming call you their leader. The group robs and intimidates people. Kin has become dissatisfied with his share.

people.name: Kin / Finds targets
people.text: Collects information and potential targets. Disappointed by recent takings, he brings a plan to burgle a house.

people.name: Tung / Uses force
people.text: Handles intimidation and violence. Quick-tempered, he resents doing the fighting for little money.

people.name: Ming / Driver and lookout
people.text: Drives and arranges escape. He wants a clear waiting place and exit before trouble begins.

people.name: Dr Lam / Programme doctor
people.text: Assesses conditioning and believes physical aversion reduces harm. Her measures of success may differ from the costs you accept.

people.name: Ms Ho / Solicitor
people.text: Helps organise your observations and records. She will not fabricate a statement or promise the outcome.

people.name: Ching / Reporter
people.text: Covers behaviour conditioning and preserves full interviews. Her position differs from that of the man funding the publicity.

people.name: Mr Ho / Campaign sponsor
people.text: Opposes the government programme and wants your story for his campaign. His ideal victim may leave no room for your full history.

people.name: Dr Lui / Independent physician
people.text: Treats post-programme reactions and refuses political declarations as diagnoses. She does not promise recovery in one session.
